slots.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.

slots.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

slots.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.
